passes.captionZh: 开头：长号、大号和圆号吹出几个又低又暖的和弦
passes.captionEn: Opening: trombones, tuba and horns breathe a few low, warm chords

passes.captionZh: 英国管的那段旋律（这里由双簧管吹），弦乐轻轻垫在下面
passes.captionEn: The famous cor anglais tune (our oboe plays it) over soft, muted strings

passes.captionZh: 单簧管接着唱一遍，圆号轻轻应和
passes.captionEn: The clarinet sings it once more; a horn answers softly

passes.captionZh: 弦乐全体唱这段旋律，长笛在上面飘着
passes.captionEn: All the strings sing it together; the flute floats above

passes.captionZh: 最后又回到开头那几个铜管和弦，安静地结束
passes.captionEn: The brass chords from the start return, and it fades to silence

str.zh: 开始只轻轻垫着和声，第三遍全体弦乐一起唱这段旋律。
str.en: They softly pad the harmony at first; in the third round all the strings sing the tune.

ww.zh: 这段旋律本来是英国管吹的，这里由双簧管吹，单簧管再唱一遍。
ww.en: The tune belongs to the cor anglais; here the oboe plays it, then the clarinet.

br.zh: 开头和结尾那几个又低又暖的和弦，是长号、大号和圆号吹的。
br.en: The low, warm chords at the start and end are trombones, tuba and horns.

perc.zh: 只在结尾敲一下很轻的定音鼓。
perc.en: Just one very soft timpani stroke near the end.
